top_signals.title: Houthi attack on Saudi airport kills 12, over 300 wounded
top_signals.summary: Saturday's attack, the deadliest in the kingdom in more than a decade, occurred without warning, with no alert issued by a threat warning system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The two tightest regions tell two very different stories about the freight market
top_signals.summary:
The Northwestern harvests are crushing capacity, but only temporarily. The Midwest’s sustained tightness tells a more meaningful long-term story about capacity.

The post The two tightest regions tell two very different stories about the freight market appeared first on FreightWaves.
